target: skill-creator/stripped-sdk-runner kit: lean CC-shaped bare_runner (library + CLI, no system-reminder, per-family profiles, cache/structured toggles), lean wire_capture debug proxy, self-contained fixture-free integration test
justification: the kit exists because claude -p injects a <system-reminder> into the scored user turn and the model reads it as task-relevant; the runner submits the CLI shape without it, per model family (4.5: enabled thinking budget 31999 at 32000; 5: adaptive thinking, 64000, effort in output_config, longer beta list) with feature-tracked betas (extended-cache-ttl only with 1h cache, structured-outputs only with output_config.format). integration_test.py mints a fresh -p reference each run and asserts relay byte-fidelity, cache-on shape parity, option contracts, clean wires, and the reminder tripwire; the oracle bit twice pre-landing (beta list lifted from the -p title side call; pre-survey profile would have sent haiku-shaped opus bodies) — both caught, both fixed; 22/22 green on haiku and on opus, plus direct-to-api CLI smoke runs (plain and structured); reasoning summaries are captured by unmasking thinking.display=summarized (the CLI omits it and the server suppresses the billed summary), with tiny adaptive bursts (<=~40 tokens) legitimately summary-less

target: stripped-sdk-runner: first-class tools/tool_choice and multi-turn stream_round in bare_runner; deep_think.py distilling the forced two-round reasoning-as-tool-call scheme; offline canned tier; integration tools and tool-loop legs
justification: the scheme moves the private reasoning pass into an ordinary deep_think call; forcing is required (unforced: opus 5/5 native thinking on the production request, fable 3/3 abandonment on the hard problem; forced rounds opened with the call 23/23) and typed answers ride write_answer's input schema because fable refuses output_config.format after a deep_think call (4/4, HTTP 200 with stop_reason refusal and zero content) while tool input schemas were never refused; the transport verdict stays counterfactual: integration_test mints fresh -p references per run, now including a really executed Read call whose follow-up request is the CLI's own tool_use/tool_result vocabulary, and the authored multi-turn transcript over stream_round must keep that vocabulary and the -p header sequence (Accept-Encoding identity the declared streaming exception) - 28/28 per family on haiku-4.5 and opus-5; offline_test (27 canned checks, no network or login) pins parse/halt/refusal/quota/transcript/CLI mechanics; deep_think live on opus-5: verdict ok, 0 thinking tokens billed, typed answer matching locally brute-forced ground truth
